params._owner: Protocol owner (can update oracle, withdraw reserves)
params._priceOracle: BDX/MUSDC pool address (used as price oracle)

params.debtToCover: Amount of MUSDC debt to repay

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.amount: Amount of MUSDC to repay (principal + interest)

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

borrow(uint256).notice: Borrow MUSDC against deposited BDX collateral.         Max borrow = collateral value USD * 75% LTV.

borrowLimit(address).notice: Max amount user can still borrow given current collateral

fundReserve(uint256).notice: Owner can add MUSDC to reserve for borrowing

getBdxPrice().notice: Get BDX price in MUSDC from the pool oracle.         Returns price scaled by 1e18 (MUSDC per BDX).         If oracle not set or pool empty, returns 1 MUSDC = 1 BDX (1e18).

getPosition(address).notice: Full position summary for a user

healthFactor(address).notice: Calculate health factor for a user.         Returns PRECISION (1e18) scaled value.         < 1e18 = liquidatable         = type(uint256).max = no debt (fully healthy)

liquidate(address,uint256).notice: Liquidate an undercollateralized position.         Health factor must be < 1.0 (1e18).         Liquidator repays debt, receives collateral + 5% bonus.

repay(uint256).notice: Repay borrowed MUSDC + accrued interest.         Pass type(uint256).max to repay full debt.

withdrawCollateral(uint256).notice: Withdraw BDX collateral.         Reverts if withdrawal would make health factor < 1.

withdrawReserve(uint256,address).notice: Owner can withdraw protocol revenue (interest collected)
